assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and other unspecified cardiac arrhythmias.
The concern is for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
The concern is for other unspecified cardiac arrhythmias.
The diagnosis codes I48.91, I48.0, and I49.9 are associated with these arrhythmias.
A 48-hour ambulatory electrocardiographic monitoring study is indicated to characterize the frequency and burden of the arrhythmic events and guide rate or rhythm control management.
The service represented by CPT 93226 is a 48-hour ambulatory electrocardiographic monitoring study.
The service represented by CPT 93226 is a 48-hour Holter monitoring study.
The 48-hour Holter monitoring study is medically necessary to assess the burden of the arrhythmias documented in this case.
